quant_scheme: per-dim global minmax, 256 buckets, dequant = min+(code+0.5)*range/256, asymmetric IP
footprint_denominator_note: 10M footprint ratios use analytic raw fp32 bytes (10M*1024*4 = 40.96 GB) as denominator; justified empirically by the 1M run where FLAT measured loaded bytes == raw vector bytes exactly (3906 MiB heap-excluded).
